about: The draft rolls of the special summary revisions with 1 January 2027 as the qualifying date, from data/india/raw/ssr_draft.csv. Written by scripts/build_ssr_draft.py.

campaign.source: CEO Andaman and Nicobar Islands, press release of 12.11.2026, printed in The Daily Telegrams, 13.11.2026

draft.note: From the Chief Electoral Officer's announcement as Pratidin Time reports it: 2,51,76,910 electors on the draft roll, of whom 1,25,87,650 are men, 1,25,88,939 are women and 321 are third gender. The report also gives 63,237 service electors and six overseas electors, and does not say whether the service or overseas electors are in the total. Assam was not in the intensive revision. The roll before this draft is the final roll of Assam's special revision of 10 February 2026, 2,49,58,139 electors, which is the figure the Assam pages carry. The report gives 4,12,344 names added and 1,93,573 deleted since then, a net rise of 2,18,771, and the figures add up for every sex.

Dainik Jagran reports from the office of the Chief Electoral Officer 7,55,89,365 electors on the draft roll, of whom 3,99,16,747 are men, 3,56,71,129 are women and 1,489 are third gender. The paper sets them beside 7,46,91,135 electors in October 2025, the roll of the Assembly election, which is a rise of 8,98,230. The base in this file is the final roll of the intensive revision of 30 September 2025, so the change of 13,97,008 from it also takes in the 4,98,778 by which the roll grew between that final roll and the roll of the Assembly election of 2025. Hindustan Times on 13 November gives the draft as 75.5 million and about 1.3 million more than the 74.2 million after the intensive revision. No press note on the draft was on ceoelection.bihar.gov.in on 13 November, where the latest press note listed is dated 23 October 2026. Service electors and the names added and deleted since the final roll were not given.

1,90,16,768 electors, 94,84,635 men, 95,31,721 women and 412 third gender, as Lalluram reports the draft roll. The report does not name the CEO's press note. Service electors and the names added and deleted were not given. No press note on the draft was on ceochhattisgarh.nic.in on the evening of 12 November.

campaign.source: CEO Goa, press note No.4-1-2026/ELEC/2852 of 11.11.2026

draft.note: The figures are the total row of the Chief Electoral Officer's summary of the draft electorate. The total of 2,73,60,254 includes 2,45,883 overseas electors, who are 2,06,943 men, 38,931 women and 9 third gender. General electors alone are 2,71,14,371, of whom 1,31,14,324 are men, 1,39,99,787 are women and 260 are third gender. The total with overseas electors is recorded here because the final roll of 21 February 2026 in final.csv counts them too. The CEO's statement as PTI reported it on ThePrint on 12 November gives the same total, men, women, third gender and number of overseas electors. A figure of 2,66,78,256 in a post by The South First on 12 November is not in the CEO's summary and was not used. Service electors and the names added and deleted since the final roll were not given.

campaign.source: Mediasaheb, 12.11.2026, report of the Chief Electoral Officer's meeting with recognised parties

draft.note: Dainik Bhaskar reports 5,47,99,628 general electors on the draft roll of 12 November, which is 8,18,563 more than the 5,39,81,065 on the final roll of 21 February 2026, and 71,530 service electors (68,978 men and 2,552 women), for 5,48,71,158 in all. It gives the rise as 3,80,169 men and 4,38,361 women, the men and women on the draft only in crore (2.82 and 2.65), and third gender electors as 937 against 904 in February. The 8,18,563 is a net change, and the names added and deleted since February were not reported. The paper also reports 72,036 polling stations after 127 were added and 21 removed, and that claims and objections close on 11 December, are to be decided by 28 December, and the final roll is due on 4 January 2027.

From the CEO's press note as India Today NE quotes it: 19,94,357 electors, 9,69,298 men, 10,24,735 women and 324 third gender. The press note itself was not found on ceomanipur.nic.in on 12 November. The report does not say whether service electors are included.

campaign.source: The South First, 12.11.2026, reporting the District Election Officer of Puducherry

draft.note: The U.T. total row of the CEO's table. The Karaikal district total of 1,57,503 agrees with the CEO's part-wise pages for constituencies 24 to 28. The five Karaikal constituency rows of the summary table add to 1,57,236, which is 267 fewer, so those rows lag the part-wise data and the total row is used. All 30 part-wise pages add to the U.T. total exactly. Service electors were not given, and no press note with figures was found.

The CEO's figures as Khas Khabar quotes them: 5,26,67,416 electors, 2,75,24,780 men, 2,51,42,052 women and 584 transgender. The report does not say whether the count covers all 200 seats. The final roll it is set against covers 199 seats and leaves out Anta, so the change from it may include Anta's electors. Service electors and the names added and deleted were not given. No press note on the draft was found on election.rajasthan.gov.in.
